act.apparent_issue: Clause enacted in November 2022 applied to August 2021 transaction

critique.reason: Temporal contradiction detected: Transaction timestamp (2021-08-14) predates the effective date (2022-11-01) of cited CBN AML/CFT Regulations 2022 Section 10(1). The 2022 regulations were not in force at the time of the transaction.
missing: applicable corporate cash threshold regulation in force prior to 2021-08-14
detected_contradictions: Transaction timestamp 2021-08-14 predates effective date 2022-11-01 of cited clause CBN-AML-2022-SEC-10-1

refine.action: Reformulate regulatory search with strict temporal filter: effective_before='2021-08-14' to retrieve the governing historical regulation in force in August 2021.

critique.reason: Temporal alignment verified. Applicable governing law at transaction time was CBN AML/CFT Regulations 2013 Section 2(1) (effective 2013-01-15). Under the 2013 rules, the corporate cash threshold was N10,000,000.00. The transaction of N7,500,000.00 does not breach statutory limit.

synthesis.summary: Investigation into corporate deposit TX-NGA-2021-0303 concluded with no suspicion. Initial flag under 2022 rules was resolved: the governing regulation in force on 2021-08-14 was CBN 2013 Section 2(1) with a N10,000,000 limit. Deposit of N7,500,000 was fully compliant.
synthesis.recommended_action: Clear compliance flag. No filing required.
